stages.title: Stage 1 · Prerequisites
stages.description: Math, Python and deep-learning groundwork before vision.

stages.title: Stage 2 · Classical Computer Vision
stages.description: How images work before deep learning automates features.

stages.title: Stage 3 · CNNs & Classification
stages.description: Learned features, backbones and transfer learning.

stages.title: Stage 4 · Training Vision Models
stages.description: Data, augmentation and the craft of making models converge.

stages.title: Stage 5 · Detection & Segmentation
stages.description: Answering “where” — the core of most production CV roles.

stages.title: Stage 6 · Transformers, 3D & Video
stages.description: Attention in vision plus depth, geometry and time.

stages.title: Stage 7 · Multimodal, Generative & SSL
stages.description: Vision-language models, generation and label-free pretraining.

stages.title: Stage 8 · Deployment & Capstones
stages.description: Ship it: optimize, serve, monitor — then prove it with projects.

nodes.title: Python & NumPy for Images
nodes.tagline: Images are just arrays — slice them fluently
nodes.description: Every image tensor is a multi-dimensional array. Get fluent with indexing, broadcasting, reshaping and vectorized ops so that later PyTorch code reads naturally instead of magically.

nodes.title: Linear Algebra
nodes.description: Images are matrices, color channels are vectors, and every rotation, projection or convolution is a linear map. Own matrix multiplication, eigen-decomposition and SVD — they resurface in calibration, compression and attention.

nodes.title: Probability & Calculus
nodes.description: Training is optimization: gradient descent on a loss surface. Distributions underlie cross-entropy, diffusion and every generative model. Learn enough to debug a diverging run instead of copying hyperparameters blindly.

nodes.title: Neural Net Basics
nodes.description: Build one small MLP from scratch: forward pass, backprop, optimizers, train/val split. If you can explain why a gradient flows, every CNN, ViT and diffusion model later is just a bigger wiring diagram.

nodes.title: Pixels & Color Spaces
nodes.description: Learn how sensors encode light: resolution, channels, bit depth, gamma. Switching color spaces (RGB → HSV/LAB) still solves real segmentation and tracking problems faster than any network.

nodes.title: Filtering & Convolution
nodes.description: Convolution as a sliding window: Gaussian blur for denoising, Sobel/Canny for edges, morphology for cleanup. This is the exact operation CNNs later learn — learn it by hand first and kernels stop being magic.

nodes.title: Keypoints & Matching
nodes.description: Before learned features there were hand-engineered ones: Harris corners, SIFT/ORB descriptors, HOG + SVM pedestrian detectors. They power panorama stitching, tracking and visual odometry — and explain what CNNs made obsolete.

nodes.title: Geometry & Camera Models
nodes.description: Cameras project a 3D world onto 2D. Learn affine/perspective transforms, homographies, lens distortion and calibration — the foundation of AR, robotics and every depth-estimation interview question.

nodes.title: Convolutional Layers
nodes.description: The inductive bias that made vision work: parameter sharing over space. Master receptive fields, stride/padding math and pooling so you can read any backbone diagram and predict its output shapes.

nodes.title: Backbones: ResNet & Beyond
nodes.description: Implement a residual block from scratch and explain why skip connections fix degradation (not just vanishing gradients — interviewers probe this). Then tour the backbone zoo you will reuse everywhere as a feature extractor.

nodes.title: Image Classification
nodes.description: Train a full classifier: splits, baselines, confusion matrices, top-k accuracy. Capstone: beat a simple baseline on CIFAR-10 with your own training loop before touching pretrained weights.

nodes.title: Transfer Learning
nodes.description: Nobody trains ImageNet from scratch at work. Learn linear probing vs full fine-tuning, freezing strategies and domain gaps — the highest-ROI skill for shipping vision features on small datasets.

nodes.title: Vision Datasets
nodes.description: Vision lives or dies on data: formats (COCO JSON), loaders, class imbalance and label quality. Learn to audit a dataset — most “model bugs” are data bugs wearing a trench coat.

nodes.title: Augmentation
nodes.description: The cheapest accuracy in vision: flips, crops, color jitter, then MixUp/CutMix and test-time augmentation. Learn which transforms preserve labels (classification) vs which must move boxes and masks too.

nodes.title: Losses & Metrics
nodes.description: Classification accuracy lies; detection needs mAP, segmentation needs IoU/Dice, tracking needs MOTA. Pair each task with its loss (focal, Dice, CIoU) and know exactly what a 2-point gain means.

nodes.title: Regularization & Debugging
nodes.description: A checklist for broken training: overfit one batch first, then scale up. Weight decay, dropout, early stopping, gradient clipping, mixed precision — plus Weights & Biases-style experiment hygiene.

nodes.title: Object Detection Basics
nodes.description: From R-CNN to RetinaNet: region proposals, anchors, NMS and why one-stage detectors won on speed. Implement NMS yourself once — you will never misread a detection paper again.

nodes.title: YOLO & Real-Time Detection
nodes.description: The industry default for real-time: train and deploy a YOLOv8 detector on a custom dataset (COCO128 → your own labels). Learn confidence thresholds, export formats and the latency/accuracy dial.

nodes.title: Segmentation
nodes.description: Pixel-perfect masks: semantic vs instance vs panoptic. Train a U-Net on a small biomedical or street-scene dataset, then graduate to Mask R-CNN for instances that overlap.

nodes.title: Tracking & Pose
nodes.description: Extend detection through time: associate boxes across frames, re-identify through occlusions, and estimate human pose keypoints. The gateway to sports analytics, retail and autonomy.

nodes.title: Vision Transformers
nodes.description: Images as sequences of patches: how self-attention replaces convolution's inductive bias with scale. Compare ViT vs Swin vs hybrid CNN-ViT, and know when transformers beat CNNs (big data) and when they don't.

nodes.title: DETR & Query Detection
nodes.description: DETR reframed detection as set prediction with bipartite matching — no anchors, no NMS. Understand queries, Hungarian loss and why convergence was slow (and how deformable attention fixed it).
subtopics: When to use DETR vs YOLO

nodes.title: Depth & 3D Vision
nodes.description: Recover the 3D world the camera saw: monocular depth ambiguity, stereo disparity, point clouds and NeRFs. Essential for robotics, autonomy and AR — and a rare differentiator on CV résumés.

nodes.title: Video Understanding
nodes.description: Add time: 3D CNNs, TimeSformer-style attention, optical flow and video object segmentation. Learn to sample clips, handle long tails of actions and evaluate on Kinetics-style benchmarks.

nodes.title: CLIP & Vision-Language
nodes.description: Contrastive image-text pretraining unlocked zero-shot classification, retrieval and open-vocabulary detection. Build a zero-shot classifier and an image search engine in an afternoon with open CLIP weights.

nodes.title: SAM & Promptable Segmentation
nodes.description: Segment Anything turned segmentation into a promptable interaction: points, boxes, masks. Combine SAM with a detector for auto-labeling pipelines that cut annotation cost by an order of magnitude.

nodes.title: Diffusion & Generative Vision
nodes.description: Reverse a noising process to generate images — then reuse it for synthetic training data, inpainting and augmentation. Grasp score matching intuition plus ControlNet-style conditioning for production use.

nodes.title: Self-Supervised Learning
nodes.description: SimCLR, MoCo, DINO and MAE extract training signal from unlabeled images — how modern backbones are actually pretrained. Fine-tune a DINO backbone on your small dataset and watch it beat supervised pretraining.

nodes.title: Optimization & Edge AI
nodes.description: A notebook model is not a product. Quantize, prune and export to ONNX/TensorRT, benchmark latency vs accuracy, and hit real-time on edge hardware without rewriting your pipeline.

nodes.title: Serving & MLOps
nodes.description: Serve behind an API with batching and GPU sharing, version datasets and weights, and monitor for drift — lighting changes silently kill vision models. Log predictions, sample for review, retrain on a schedule.

nodes.title: Capstone: Real-Time System
nodes.description: End-to-end real-time counter: detect, track and count objects from a webcam or traffic video at 25+ FPS on your hardware, with an optimized export and a small dashboard. This is the project interviewers actually click.

nodes.title: Capstone: Multimodal Search
nodes.description: Natural-language search over an image collection: CLIP embeddings in a vector index, SAM masks on click, zero-shot tags for the long tail. Deploys as a shareable web demo — the portfolio piece that looks like 2026.
